name: funo-competitor-app
description: Capacitor shell for the fun_o competitor UI

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run cap:config:hosted && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run cap:config:hosted && npx cap sync android

scripts.cap:sync:android:bundled:release: npm run cap:config:bundled:release && npx cap sync android
